description: This file contains React components for rendering overlay dialogs in a game UI, including a Card component for dialog content and an OverlayLayer component managing different overlay modes such as help, settings, and results.

methods.name: Card
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a stylized modal card with a title, children content, and action buttons.

methods.name: OverlayLayer
methods.description: Main React component managing overlay dialogs based on application state, providing different content for help, settings, and game result overlays.
